summaries.en: Graphify is a Python-based tool that converts codebases—including documentation, SQL schemas, and PDFs—into queryable knowledge graphs. Designed as a skill for AI assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI, it employs local deterministic AST parsing to explain every relationship without using a vector store. The project is highly popular on GitHub, boasting over 134,000 stars and 12,800 forks.
